headline: San Francisco Orders Meta to Stop ‘Allowing’ AI Child Abuse Ads
context: The City Attorney’s Office has asked Meta to explain how the harmful ads repeatedly ran on Facebook and Instagram. The company claims the ads are not under the city’s jurisdiction.
